# Bookkeepers South Africa

> Bookkeeping, payroll and SARS tax compliance services for small and growing businesses in South Africa, with offices in Cape Town and Johannesburg.

Bookkeepers South Africa is an accounting and tax consulting firm founded by Lindsay Vermeulen in Century City, Cape Town, now ten years in practice with a second office in Johannesburg. The practice handles bookkeeping, payroll processing, SARS tax submissions and CIPC business registrations for small and medium businesses, and holds CIBA, SAIT, Xero Advisor Certified and Sage certifications. Lindsay Vermeulen is also a registered Commissioner of Oaths. The practice is rated 4.9 out of 5 from 18 Google reviews.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://www.bookkeepersincapetown.co.za/services.html): Bookkeeping, payroll, SARS tax compliance, and business (CIPC) registrations
- [Accreditations](https://www.bookkeepersincapetown.co.za/accreditations.html): CIBA, SAIT, Xero Advisor Certified and Sage certifications held by the team
